lessons_used: Predictions were generally too high, except for the pet companion redesign where the prediction was too low.

candidates.why: The choose_path step has a conversion of 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion or hesitation when evaluating options.

candidates.score_note: Addresses initial 23.8% dropoff and hesitation, but layout changes show modest historic lift.

waiting.headline: Your Pet Companion is Arriving
